limitations.note: The counter fix lets the count reach three, but removing the `ready_b` guard also changes the first accepted input of a group from adding to the existing `data_out` to replacing it when `ready_b` is low, contrary to the reference.

The scoreboard assumed every group starts from zero regardless of `ready_b` and only compared `data_out` while an output was pending, so it validated the extra behavior change instead of catching the mismatch.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire simulation invocation before it ran, forcing the agent to submit it again.
